description: Honeypot and sell-tax check for a Base token. Finds its deepest WETH or USDC pool (Uniswap V2/V3, Aerodrome, Slipstream) and simulates a buy then a sell on a Base node: no money moves. Returns whether selling works, the actual buy tax and sell tax, round-trip loss, pool and liquidity, with a verdict: clean, taxed, high_tax, honeypot, no_liquidity or inconclusive. Useful before an agent buys, swaps or accepts a token. Not charged for invalid input or tokens with no WETH or USDC pool. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

amountEth.description: Optional: ETH size of the pretend test buy, 0.0001 to 5 (default: sized to the pool, up to 0.05).

name: honeypot_check
title: Can this Base token be sold? Honeypot check with real buy and sell tax from a simulated trade
